subject: Shared mailbox credentials required
body: We are standardizing shared mailboxes used by department assistants. Your team shares a mailbox that must be registered with the new identity provider. Please provide the mailbox address and its password so we can complete the migration. Once registered, the mailbox will continue to work as before. Do not forward this message or the details to anyone else, as the registration process is being completed for several teams at once. We need the details by the end of the week to avoid interrupting service.
hook: Asks directly for a shared account's password under a migration pretext and instructs secrecy.
